species.name: Trout
why: Water 52°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 28–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 52°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 34–70 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–32 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
